## Change type
- [ ] Dataset
- [ ] Method
- [ ] Correction
- [ ] Documentation/tooling

## Primary sources
List authoritative provider, paper, terms/license, and implementation links.

## Checks
- [ ] Original creators are clearly attributed.
- [ ] Dataset/code/weights terms are separated.
- [ ] Implementation relationship is accurate.
- [ ] No data, weights, credentials, signed URLs, or copied figures are included.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_catalog.py` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_no_restricted_files.py` passes.
- [ ] Generated pages were rebuilt.
